description: This file contains a test class 'FvpDevicesTest' that performs hardware device and CPU hotplug tests on a system, including device presence checks, CPU enable/disable, and device-specific tests like RTC, watchdog, networking, and RNG, using SSH commands and system file interactions.

classes.name: FvpDevicesTest
classes.description: A test class for verifying device presence, CPU hotplug functionality, and specific hardware components like RTC, watchdog, networking, and RNG on a system.

methods.name: run_cmd
methods.description: Executes a command with optional retries, handling SSH return codes and delays.

methods.name: check_devices
methods.description: Checks for the presence of a minimum number of devices of a specific class and verifies driver usage.

methods.name: check_rng
methods.description: Checks for the presence of a specific RNG device by grepping system files.

methods.name: set_cpu
methods.description: Enables or disables a CPU core by writing to sysfs and verifying the change.

methods.name: test_cpu_hotplug
methods.description: Tests CPU hotplug functionality, including enabling/disabling cores and ensuring at least one core remains active.

methods.name: test_rtc
methods.description: Verifies RTC device presence and runs hwclock.

methods.name: test_networking
methods.description: Verifies networking device presence and outbound connectivity.

methods.name: test_virtiorng
methods.description: Verifies virtio RNG device presence and reads from /dev/hwrng.
